japanese: 止まったとき何をしていましたか？（任意）
german: Was hast du gemacht als es abstürzte? (optional)
korean: 멈췄을 때 무엇을 하고 계셨나요? (선택 사항)

japanese: このプレイテストについて

Source: When you send a report we upload your description, the last 2 minutes of gameplay video, a world snapshot, the packet log, the Unity log and a screenshot. A session summary and an event list are sent automatically when you quit. Reports are recorded under your Steam account (your SteamID and public display name). Nothing else leaves your PC.
english: When you send a report we upload your description, the last 2 minutes of gameplay video, a world snapshot, the packet log, the Unity log and a screenshot. A session summary and an event list are sent automatically when you quit. Reports are recorded under your Steam account (your SteamID and public display name). Nothing else leaves your PC.
japanese: 報告を送ると、説明文・直前2分の録画・ワールドのスナップショット・パケットログ・Unityログ・スクリーンショットが送信されます。終了時にはセッションの要約とイベント列が自動送信されます。報告はあなたのSteamアカウント（SteamIDと公開表示名）に紐づけて記録されます。これ以外はPCから送信されません。
german: Wenn du eine Meldung sendest, werden dein Text, die letzten 2 Minuten Spielaufnahme, ein Welt-Snapshot, das Paketprotokoll, das Unity-Log und ein Screenshot übertragen. Beim Beenden werden automatisch eine Sitzungszusammenfassung und eine Ereignisliste gesendet. Berichte werden deinem Steam-Konto (SteamID und öffentlicher Anzeigename) zugeordnet gespeichert. Sonst verlässt nichts deinen PC.
korean: 신고를 보내면 작성하신 설명, 최근 2분간의 게임 플레이 영상, 월드 스냅샷, 패킷 로그, Unity 로그, 스크린샷이 업로드됩니다. 종료할 때는 세션 요약과 이벤트 목록이 자동으로 전송됩니다. 신고는 Steam 계정(SteamID와 공개 표시 이름)으로 기록됩니다. 그 외의 정보는 PC 밖으로 나가지 않습니다.

Source: Could not answer. Please press again.
english: Could not answer. Please press again.
japanese: 応答できませんでした。もう一度押してください。

Source: Your answer was received. This closes shortly.
english: Your answer was received. This closes shortly.
japanese: 応答を受け付けました。まもなく閉じます。
german: Deine Antwort wurde empfangen. Dies schließt sich gleich.
korean: 응답이 접수되었습니다. 곧 이 화면이 닫힙니다.

Source: Disconnected. Please press again once it reconnects.
english: Disconnected. Please press again once it reconnects.
japanese: 接続が切れています。つながったらもう一度押してください。
german: Verbindung getrennt. Bitte erneut drücken sobald sie wiederhergestellt ist.
korean: 연결이 끊어졌습니다. 다시 연결된 후 한 번 더 눌러 주세요.

Source: The answer arrived but this screen did not close. Please press again.
english: The answer arrived but this screen did not close. Please press again.
japanese: 応答は届きましたが画面が閉じません。もう一度押してください。
german: Die Antwort kam an aber dieser Bildschirm schloss nicht. Bitte erneut drücken.
korean: 응답은 도착했지만 이 화면이 닫히지 않았습니다. 다시 눌러 주세요.

Source: The title confirmations are still being prepared. Try again in a moment.
english: The title confirmations are still being prepared. Try again in a moment.
japanese: タイトルの確認を準備中です。少し待ってからもう一度お試しください。
german: Die Bestätigungen auf dem Titelbildschirm werden noch vorbereitet. Bitte versuche es gleich noch einmal.
korean: 타이틀 확인 절차를 아직 준비하고 있습니다. 잠시 후 다시 시도해 주세요.

Source: Could not connect to Steam. Start Steam and try again.
english: Could not connect to Steam. Start Steam and try again.
japanese: Steamに接続できないため開始できません。Steamを起動してからもう一度お試しください。
german: Keine Verbindung zu Steam. Starte Steam und versuche es erneut.
korean: Steam에 연결하지 못했습니다. Steam을 실행한 뒤 다시 시도해 주세요.

Source: Could not identify this device. The game cannot start.
english: Could not identify this device. The game cannot start.
japanese: この端末の識別子を取得できないため開始できません。
german: Dieses Gerät konnte nicht identifiziert werden. Das Spiel kann nicht starten.
korean: 이 기기를 식별하지 못했습니다. 게임을 시작할 수 없습니다.

Source: The same player is already connected.
english: The same player is already connected.
japanese: 同じプレイヤーが既に接続しています。

Source: Could not verify this build. The game cannot start.
english: Could not verify this build. The game cannot start.
japanese: ビルド情報を確認できないため開始できません。
german: Dieser Build konnte nicht überprüft werden. Das Spiel kann nicht gestartet werden.
korean: 이 빌드를 확인하지 못했습니다. 게임을 시작할 수 없습니다.

Source: The server returned an unknown connection response.
english: The server returned an unknown connection response.
japanese: サーバーから不明な接続応答を受け取りました。
german: Der Server hat eine unbekannte Verbindungsantwort zurückgegeben.
korean: 서버가 알 수 없는 연결 응답을 반환했습니다.
